findings.description: The sync wrapper assigns `copy._local.statistics = self._local.statistics`, which is the old dict, instead of the shared `stats` dict. The async version correctly uses `stats`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any call to a sync-decorated function. The copy records attempt counts into the old `self._local.statistics`, while `wrapped_f.statistics` is the `stats` dict that was just cleared and never updated. Impact: `wrapped_f.statistics` stays empty after a call, which breaks the statistics feature. If `self._local.statistics` was not yet initialised, the line may also raise AttributeError or share state across calls.
